family_wise_note: each shell coverage is measured under the non-Gaussian distance-error stressor so the shells genuinely differ; the disclosed least-favourable value is the minimum over shells and components (a real depth-dependent degradation, not Monte-Carlo noise). A simultaneous family-wise statement over the 3-shell grid would use a per-shell Bonferroni confidence 1-(1-c)/3 (not computed here); same-shell regions are not treated as independent
